action.prompt: A file was just saved in the INVOX project. Quickly scan the saved file content for accidental secrets: AWS access keys (AKIA...), secret keys, passwords, .env variable assignments with real values, Antideploy tokens, DynamoDB credentials, or any hardcoded API keys. If you find anything suspicious, STOP and alert Nidhi immediately with the file name and the type of secret detected. Do not proceed with any other task until the secret is resolved. If nothing suspicious is found, stay silent.
